chunks: And they returned with God's favour and grace without harm, for they attended the pleasure of God; and great is the benevolence of God.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that believers returned with God's favour and no harm touched them?
ai.summary: In the context of the Battle of Uhud, this verse highlights the spiritual victory of the believers who, despite physical setbacks, returned with divine favor because they adhered to the Prophet's command and sought Allah's pleasure. Shia scholarship often emphasizes this 'pleasure of Allah' (Ridwan Allah) as a precursor to the concept of spiritual infallibility (Ismah) and the enduring guidance of the Ahl al-Bayt, illustrating that true success lies in divine grace rather than mere material outcome.
